rows.grounds: nom.sg.m. of Skanda; final visarga becomes o before mā
past participle used adjectivally, agreeing with the divine pair in locative context
bahuvrīhi compound epithet of Śiva: candra + śekhara

items.question: To which alternative divine forms may the prepared offerings be duly presented?
premises: The offerings may be presented to Skanda accompanied by Mā.
Alternatively, the offerings may be presented to the moon-crested deity without Skanda.
The particle vā marks these as valid alternative recipients.
items.inference: Therefore, the ritual offerings may be directed either to Skanda together with Mā or to the moon-crested Śiva alone.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of sahite in relation to the pair skando mā is contextually inferred as accompaniment.
items.plain_english: The offerings may be presented to Skanda accompanied by Mā, or alternatively to the moon-crested Śiva without Skanda.
